question: As per the Constitution of India, every Legislative Assembly of every State, unless sooner dissolved, shall continue for _____ from the date appointed for its first meeting.
solution:
The correct answer is __**five years**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• State Legislative Assembly​

 
 
• It is a Legislative body of the state.
 
• Subject to the provisions of Article 333, the Legislative Assembly of each State shall consist of not more than five hundred, and not less than sixty, members chosen by direct election from territorial constituencies in the State.
 
• Each State shall be divided into territorial constituencies.
 
• Members of the State Legislative Assembly, are elected directly by voting, from a set of candidates who stands in their respective constituencies.
 
 
 
• **​A Member of the Legislative Assembly (MLA) is a representative, elected by the voters of an electoral district (constituency) to the legislature of the State government in the Indian system of government.**
 
 
• From each constituency, the people elect one representative who then becomes a member of the Legislative Assembly (MLA). 
 
 
 
• Lok Sabha
 
 
• It is the lower house of the Indian Parliament.
 
• It is composed of representatives of the people chosen by direct election on the basis of adult suffrage.
 
• The maximum strength of the House envisaged by the Constitution is 552.
 
• 25 years is the minimum age for holding office in the Lok Sabha.
 
• The term of the members of Lok Sabha is a maximum of 5 years.
 
• Motions of no confidence against the government can be introduced and passed in the Lok Sabha.
 
• Money bills can only be introduced in the Lok Sabha.
